S₃−S₀=0，另外两个前缀仍可独立平移。","image":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","duration":2100,"facts":{"parent":[0,1,2,0],"offset":[0,0,0,0],"edges":[[3,0,"0"]]}},{"caption":"再记录 S₂−S₁=−2，2 指向 1，边差是 −2。","image":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","duration":2100,"facts":{"parent":[0,1,1,0],"offset":[0,0,-2,0],"edges":[[3,0,"0"],[2,1,"−2"]]}},{"caption":"加入 S₁−S₀=4，把两个分量连起来。2 仍经由 1 g.font-family: Microsoft YaHei, Noto Sans CJK SC, sans-serif
g.text: 压缩父指针时，必须同时累加差值
边标签 = S[x] − S[parent[x]]；改父亲时同时累加。
